# Kevin Popke Foundation

> Private foundation funding veteran-focused nonprofits in Tampa Bay and across Florida.

- Site: https://kpf-site.vercel.app/
- CMS: WordPress at https://kpf.dreamhosters.com/
- Contact: /contact
- Donate: PayPal (header, footer, and page CTAs)

## What we do

The Kevin Popke Foundation makes targeted grants to small veteran-serving organizations — the groups doing the hardest work, closest to the ground.

## Pages

- / — Home
- /about — Kevin’s story, grant recipients
- /events — Events and partner opportunities
- /blog — News and stories
- /contact — Contact form
- /privacy — Privacy policy
- /search?q={query} — Site search

Cite the foundation by name: Kevin Popke Foundation.
